starter_decks_intro: Beginner-friendly decks from community deckbuilders, guaranteed buildable using only cards from the Current Environment. There's also a team building feature where you can see clearly the card overlaps and resolve it before you gather your cards for everyone in your play group!
starter_decks_arkhamdb_note: This deck was originally published by {author} on ArkhamDB. At my request, they kindly allowed me to include a copy of it here for more beginners out there to see. Since social features are available in ArkhamDB, please go there to like, favorite, and comment / interact with the author if you love this deck.
starter_decks_filter_products_help: Check any other purchases you have in addition to the Core Set 2026. The results below will be filtered accordingly to what you could build.
starter_decks_none_match: No starter deck matches your filtering criteria.
starter_decks_team_empty: You can mark each starter deck you want to use with the "Add to Team" button in each deck's page.
